content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Research Question 3 / Phase 2","problem":"Pure water flux recovery on bench-scale membranes only checks whether the CIP method cleans the membrane — it cannot show that the inline UV/conductivity endpoint (SYN-PAT-026) detects the actual cleaning state better than a time-based protocol unless tested on membranes fouled with the authentic protease broth foulant, yet no such positive-control condition is specified.","fix":"Add a condition where bench membranes are fouled with authentic broth to a defined resistance level before comparing endpoint criteria, so the measure tests detection of real foulant removal, not just cleaning-agent washout."}],"unconfirmed":["Access to production UF skid and two years of logged batch data","Consumables and membrane samples for testing"]}
